title: TravelAgent: Generative agents in the built environment
decision_basis: Full-text adjudication confirms first-person visual observations, depth, collision, discovery-map, compass, and spatial-memory inputs; current experiments remain single-agent navigation, so bridge only.

title: Exploring Large Language Model-Driven Agents for Environment-Aware Spatial Interactions and Conversations in Virtual Reality Role-Play Scenarios
decision_basis: Primary-source/abstract review supports text-prompt schema over VR spots, objects, characters, and communications in five role-play scenarios with 14 participants; bridge because it is human-AI spatial interaction rather than population simulation.

title: When LLMs Recognize Your Space: Research on Experiences with Spatially Aware LLM Agents
decision_basis: PubMed/abstract evidence supports three spatial-awareness conditions in counseling conversations and observed differences in copresence, trust, alliance, and self-disclosure; bridge because it is human-agent interaction rather than population simulation.

title: A Context-Aware Onboarding Agent for Metaverse Powered by Large Language Models
decision_basis: Primary-source abstract and metadata support metaverse onboarding with short-term spatiotemporal context, long-term exploration context, ablation study, and user study; bridge because the system is a single-agent onboarding assistant.

title: A Voice-Controlled Dialogue System for NPC Interaction using Large Language Models
decision_basis: Downloaded PDF and ACL source confirm Unity/NPC interaction; bridge because it is a single user-to-NPC interface.

title: Mixed-Initiative Dialogue Management for Human-Virtual Agents Interaction in Forum Theatre Inspired Training
decision_basis: Downloaded PDF confirms a VR training tool with virtual agents and reflection/replay; bridge because it is training interaction rather than social simulation.

title: TongSIM: A General Platform for Simulating Intelligent Machines
decision_basis: PDF/source review confirms high-fidelity embodied platform, indoor scenes, outdoor town, multi-agent social simulation affordances, and human-AI collaboration; bridge because it is platform-like.

title: S^3: Social-network Simulation System with Large Language Model-Empowered Agents
decision_basis: Full-text recheck supports directed follow graph, followee message exposure, user profiles, memory, and propagation, but no agent-facing global centrality/community summary; under widened digital-environment rule it enters bridge_core as L3.

title: Unveiling the collective behaviors of large language model-based autonomous agents in an online community: A social network analysis perspective
decision_basis: Primary-source review confirms Chirper online community, profiles, posts, follows, replies, histories, and observed network formation; SNA metrics are researcher-side results rather than agent-facing global structure, so code as L3.

title: An Open-Domain Avatar Chatbot by Exploiting a Large Language Model
decision_basis: Avatar-based immersive interaction is socially situated, but evidence is weaker than the main bridge-core candidates.

title: Cognitive Agents in Urban Mobility: Integrating LLM Reasoning into Multi-Agent Simulations
decision_basis: Full-text sanity check confirms 320 cognitive agents in a geospatial transport simulation with disruption adaptation; bridge because direct interpersonal interaction is weak.

title: Building Cooperative Embodied Agents Modularly with Large Language Models (CoELA)
decision_basis: Strong embodied multi-agent cooperation evidence with raw sensory observations and costly communication; bridge because it is primarily a cooperation benchmark.
